showcase.title: CustomTailor.store
showcase.intro: An interactive custom tailoring platform with fabric selection, garment customization, live previews, dynamic pricing, and personalized ordering.

stages.title: Choose fabric
stages.text: Customers browse the fabric range and pick the one for their garment.
stages.alt: Fabric selection panel next to the suit preview

stages.title: Customize the garment
stages.text: Style options and garment details are chosen step by step.
stages.alt: Style options for body style, vents and lapels

stages.title: Live preview
stages.text: Every choice is reflected in a live preview of the garment.
stages.alt: Suit preview updated to the selected plaid fabric

stages.title: Dynamic pricing
stages.text: The price updates instantly as options change.
stages.alt: Price updated to $300 after choosing a different fabric

stages.title: Personalized order
stages.text: The finished configuration is placed as a personalized order.
stages.alt: Configured suit added to the cart, with the View cart button

deployment.title: Deployed where you need it, kept running after launch.
deployment.intro: We set up servers on major clouds, VPS providers and shared hosting, ship your project with Docker and CI/CD, then keep it updated, monitored and backed up.

maintenance.title: Updates & security patches
maintenance.text: Server, framework and dependency updates, applied and tested.

maintenance.title: Uptime monitoring
maintenance.text: Alerts when the site or API stops responding, so problems are fixed early.

maintenance.title: Backups & recovery
maintenance.text: Automated database and file backups, with restores that are tested.

maintenance.title: SSL & domains
maintenance.text: Certificates renewed automatically and DNS records kept in order.

maintenance.title: Fixes & improvements
maintenance.text: Bug fixes, performance tuning and small updates after launch.
